description: Register a new outbound webhook that sends HTTP POST requests to an external URL when specified bot events occur. Supported events: message.created, message.assistant, conversation.created, conversation.escalated, conversation.closed, bot.paused, bot.resumed.

botId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to create the outbound webhook for

eventTypes.description: Array of event types that should trigger this webhook

filterPrompt.description: Optional LLM prompt to selectively filter which events are forwarded (e.g., 'only forward escalations about billing')

name.description: Human-readable name for the outbound webhook

url.description: Destination URL that will receive webhook event payloads (HTTPS recommended)

name: neuron_create_outbound_webhook
title: Create Outbound Webhook
